items.period: Shang-period oracle script style (approximate form tradition; file itself is a modern digital redraw)
items.caption: A modern vector redraw representing 老 in Shang oracle-script style. The paleographic account describes the early graph as a bent person with long hair and a staff.
items.alt: Single stylized oracle-script form of 老, reproduced as a modern SVG redraw.
items.selection_reason: Character-specific source-page provenance identifies this as 老 in oracle-script style; the form tradition illustrates the early pictographic interpretation described by CUHK.
items.rights: The Wikimedia Commons file page states the digital representation is public domain. It is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

limitations.text: The proposed image has not been visually inspected in this research stage; its depiction and provenance are taken from the file description. It should not be described as an ancient artifact photo.
